name: hydrastro/astrx
description: AstrX: a modular, JavaScript-free PHP web framework and the website built on it

suggest.ext-sodium: Signed downloads and the encrypted tipline (both refuse to run without it)
suggest.ext-posix: Lets the server-secret check compare file ownership with the running user
suggest.ext-zend-opcache: Invalidates cached config and language files immediately after an admin save

scripts-descriptions.check: Run the zero-dependency integrity gates (architecture, modules, config, i18n, diagnostics)
